rights_access_consent_cultural_state.license: unresolved here; dataset card directs to parent dataset for licensing

explicit_gaps: Resolve parent corpus provenance and license at the exact version used by the derived dataset.
Pin immutable provider revision and materialize/hash the Mundari configuration.
Deterministically recount Mundari rows and reconcile stable IDs against the parent corpus.
Audit translator/speaker/participant provenance and consent where applicable.
Apply cultural-access review before any culturally sensitive row is exposed or promoted.
